description: Set footnote and endnote options: numbering, prefix and suffix, reference and text styles, separator, spacing, rules, and the endnote header, scope and frame (Type > Document Footnote Options, Type > Document Endnote Options); and whether Word footnotes and endnotes come in on import (Word Import Options).

endnotes.description: Endnote options; only the ones given change

frame.description: Put endnotes on a new page at the end, or load them in the place cursor (needs someone to place them)

markerCharacterStyle.description: Character style for the reference number

markerPosition.description: Position of the reference number in the text

restartNumbering.description: Number continuously or restart in each story

scope.description: Endnotes for the whole document or per story

separator.description: Text between the endnote number and its text (^t is a tab)

showPrefixSuffix.description: Where the prefix and suffix appear

titleStyle.description: Paragraph style for the endnote header

footnotes.description: Footnote options; only the ones given change

allowSplit.description: Allow footnotes to split across columns

color.description: Rule colour: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

gapColor.description: Gap colour for dashed or dotted rules: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

firstBaselineMinimum.description: Minimum first baseline offset, in mm

firstBaselineOffset.description: First baseline offset of footnote text

markerCharacterStyle.description: Character style for the reference number

markerPosition.description: Position of the reference number in the text

placeAtBottomOfText.description: Place end-of-story footnotes at the bottom of the text instead of the column

restartNumbering.description: Restart numbering every page, spread or section, or never

ruleAbove.description: Rule above the first footnote in a column

color.description: Rule colour: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

gapColor.description: Gap colour for dashed or dotted rules: a swatch name or "#RRGGBB"

separator.description: Text between the footnote number and its text (^t is a tab)

showPrefixSuffix.description: Where the prefix and suffix appear: the reference, the footnote, both or neither

spaceBefore.description: Minimum space before the first footnote, in mm

spanColumns.description: Span footnotes across the columns of multi-column frames

wordImport.description: Word and RTF import options for notes (application preferences)

importAsStaticEndnotes.description: Import endnotes as static text instead of live endnotes

name: set_note_options
title: Set Note Options
